findings.title: READY_FOR_8X3 fall-through on unclassified run failures
Asymmetric exception containment: PLAN caught+evented, INTEGRATE uncaught
evidence: 16/16 run-level failures escaped at INTEGRATE with empty supervisor_failures digests

findings.title: Run failures persist str(exc)[:500] only; actual model outputs, validation errors and retry feedback are never serialized
evidence: FailureLayer enum (metrics.py:224-242) has 18 fine-grained members; only RUNTIME is used at the boundary

findings.title: map_provider_exception misclasses openai.APITimeoutError as AGENT_INTERNAL_FAILURE (never AGENT_TIMEOUT)
evidence: openai.APITimeoutError MRO: APITimeoutError->APIConnectionError->APIError (no TimeoutError base, no status_code)

findings.title: LLM_MAX_RETRIES is dead configuration on the agent path
evidence: httpserver/config.py:263 defines llm_max_retries; zero consumers in httpserver/services/investigation/
httpserver/services/investigation/agent_model_adapter.py builds AsyncOpenAI via OpenAIProvider without max_retries -> SDK default 2

findings.title: Production run-level timeout not armed: generation_params has no timeout_seconds key
evidence: httpserver/services/benchmarks/production_executor.py:95-99 (budget = timeout_seconds or generation_params.get('timeout_seconds') -> None -> wait_for unbounded)
step-5-preview run manifests: generation_params = {temperature, max_tokens, thinking_mode, reasoning_effort}

findings.title: Non-terminalized attribution text mislabels every failed run as M7 MODEL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_FAILURE
evidence: step-5-preview screening-report.json non_terminalized entries show 'Request timed out.' under the M7-schema label

findings.title: 0.5 'collapse ceiling' constant serves two different denominators across eras (wave-1 delegation-axis vs screening run-axis)
evidence: disposition_openrouter_8x1.py applies it to run_axis_rate = output-failed runs / scheduled

findings.title: step-5-preview latency exceeds the frozen 120s per-attempt budget at INTEGRATE (5/5 runs, 362s = 3x120s+overhead)
Three independent providers' models fail the INTEGRATE output-tool contract at the same protocol position while the incumbent passes; actual outputs unlogged
evidence: schema asymmetry: INTEGRATE_V2 9833 bytes/19 $defs vs PLAN_V2 2686/3 (agent_integration_v2.py:205,263)
b2-restart specialist diagnosis (specialist-output-diagnosis.v1.json) proves capture was possible but was specialist-only and not re-armed
findings.note: prior is strong (3/3 models x 11/11 first-INTEGRATE failures vs incumbent supervisor 0 failures) but the directive forbids model attribution without output-level evidence

findings.title: Protocol reachability: valid outputs pass the full production chain for all five dispositions
evidence: tests/unit/investigation/test_protocol_feasibility_audit.py (10 tests: 5 dispositions -> terminalization; W3 fail-closed; contradiction; fail-closed invalid ref; FinalizationGate PASS)

findings.title: Terminalization metric: single frozen definition across all disposition scripts; historical 20/24, 10/24 reproduced exactly
evidence: scripts/disposition_wave2_final.py:41 OPEN_STATUSES imported unchanged by wave2_screening and openrouter_8x1
